description: React component for a paginated list of groups or teams in the Mattermost admin console, with navigation controls and dynamic data fetching.

classes.name: AbstractList
classes.description: A React component that displays a paginated list of groups or teams with navigation controls.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state with loading true and page 0.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Triggers initial data fetch when component mounts.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Handles navigation to the previous page, updating state and fetching data.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Handles navigation to the next page, updating state and fetching data.

methods.name: renderHeader
methods.description: Renders the header if data exists.

methods.name: renderRows
methods.description: Renders loading spinner, empty message, or current page data rows.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Fetches data for the specified page and updates loading state.

methods.name: getPaging
methods.description: Calculates and returns pagination info: startCount, endCount, total.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, including list, footer, and navigation buttons.
